February, 1985. Funchal, on the island of Madeira. A kit man's son is born. His name? Cristiano Ronaldo.
At twelve, he left home alone for Sporting Lisbon's academy. At fifteen, a racing heart needed surgery. He was back training within days.
In 2003, he tore Manchester United apart in a friendly. Days later, Sir Alex Ferguson signed him, for twelve million pounds.
By 2008, he had won the Champions League and the Ballon Dor. A year later, Real Madrid paid a world record eighty million.
Five Ballon Dors. Five Champions Leagues. Over nine hundred goals.
From a kit man's son, to a global icon. But is he the greatest of all time? Tell me in the comments.
